audit_scope: Implementation and reproducibility settings only; no B1-B12 experiment was rerun and no model was retrained.
evidence_priority: README and run guides, treated as secondary when they conflict with final artifacts

confirmation.b11: Exact environment is embedded in the final B11 artifact.
confirmation.b12: B12 provenance records the same repository virtual-environment interpreter and was produced on the currently corroborated final host; its JSON does not independently embed an OS string.

xgboost_execution.evidence: B11 records CPU execution with tree_method=hist and no device=cuda; config.py and B9 final artifacts record n_jobs=4.

external_llm.explanation: The reported classifier and deterministic replay paths are local. Full ReAct can use an external OpenAI-compatible backend when the optional integration and API key are configured, but the code falls back to a local heuristic LLM.
